about: Parameters for the Simulate model of sketch 22. Every value says where it comes from and whether it is synthetic. Replace placeholders with published values and update 'status'. 2026-11-23: fleece and ice albedos replaced with AINEVA 74 field values; operator's 36%/57% confirmed there.
model: Enhanced temperature-index melt: melt per hour = tf * T + srf * (1 - albedo) * G, when T > tt. Applied to daily means x 24 h.

albedo_ice.source: AINEVA Neve e Valanghe 74 (Diolaiuti, Senese et al.), Presena, mean of hourly values 31 Jul-29 Aug 2010, one radiometer on each surface; 'unmodified glacier surface', bare ice at the station from 16 Jul

albedo_snow.status: SYNTHETIC placeholder; no field value found yet

albedo_fleece.source: AINEVA Neve e Valanghe 74 (Diolaiuti, Senese et al.), Presena, mean of hourly values 31 Jul-29 Aug 2010, one radiometer on each surface
albedo_fleece.status: documented (one site, one month, new fleece)

ablation_reduction_pct.source: AINEVA 74, 31 Jul-29 Aug 2010, radiative terms only

literature_reduction_pct.source: Olefs & Fischer 2008 (2003-2008); Diolaiuti et al. 2009a (2008), as cited in AINEVA 74
